item.description: The _quotep3 function has a bug where it tries to call .decode() on a string that is already decoded, causing an AttributeError. The function attempts to call .decode() on a string object instead of a bytes object.
item.contract: The _quotep3 function should properly handle both bytes and string inputs and return a properly encoded string without throwing AttributeError.

item.description: The _quotep3b function has an incorrect implementation that doesn't properly handle bytes replacement. It calls w8dec() on the result of quote() which may return a string instead of bytes, causing an error when trying to call .replace() on it.
item.contract: The _quotep3b function should consistently work with bytes objects and return properly encoded bytes without throwing AttributeError.

item.description: The _quotep3b function has a potential error when processing the quoted result - it doesn't properly handle the case where quote() returns a string instead of bytes.
item.contract: The _quotep3b function should consistently process bytes and return properly formatted bytes without throwing AttributeError.

item.description: There is a missing import statement for the 'tarfile' module which is used in test_dots.py but not imported in the main module, causing a NameError when the tarfile module is referenced.
item.contract: The tarfile module should be properly imported to prevent runtime errors in tests that rely on tarfile functionality.

item.description: The quotep alias points to _quotep3 but the implementation has a logic error that prevents proper handling of the quote operation result.
item.contract: The quotep alias should correctly point to a functioning implementation of URL quoting that handles both string and bytes inputs correctly.
